title: A differentiability framework for zigzag persistent homology via linear interpolation
abstract: arXiv:2609.39242v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Persistent homology can be differentiated and incorporated into learning pipelines, but no analogous framework exists for zigzag persistence, which is needed when the underlying topological structure evolves non-monotonically over time. We develop such a framework for sequences of simplicial complexes obtained by thresholding time-dependent filtering values on a fixed complex. By assigning persistence diagram endpoints the real-valued times at which linearly interpolated filtering values cross the threshold, we transfer the continuity of the filtering values to the diagram points. This yields smooth local lifts of the resulting persistence-diagram-valued map, from which we derive differentials almost everywhere under mild regularity conditions on the parametrization of the filtering values. We prove local Lipschitz continuity outside an explicit measure-zero exclusion set; standard stochastic subgradient convergence guarantees therefore

translated_title: 基于线性插值的之字形持续同调可微性框架
translated_abstract: 持续同调可以被微分并纳入学习管线中，但对于之字形持续同调，目前尚不存在类似的框架，而在底层拓扑结构随时间非单调演化时，之字形持续同调是必需的。我们针对在固定复形上对随时间变化的过滤值进行阈值化所得到的单纯复形序列，开发了这样一个框架。通过为持续性图的端点分配线性插值过滤值越过阈值的实值时间，我们将过滤值的连续性传递到图上的点。这产生了所得持续性图值映射的平滑局部提升，在对过滤值参数化施加温和的正则性条件下，我们由此推导出几乎处处可微的微分。我们证明了在某个显式的零测度排除集之外具有局部Lipschitz连续性；因此标准的随机次梯度收敛保证……
tldr: 本文首次为之字形持续同调建立了可微性框架，通过将线性插值过滤值跨越阈值的实值时间赋予持续性图端点，在温和正则性条件下实现几乎处处可微，并在显式零测度集之外证明局部Lipschitz连续性，从而使标准随机次梯度收敛保证可应用于学习管线。
en_tdlr: This paper develops the first differentiability framework for zigzag persistent homology by assigning persistence diagram endpoints the real-valued times when linearly interpolated filtering values cross the threshold, yielding almost-everywhere differentiability and local Lipschitz continuity outside an explicit measure-zero set, so standard stochastic subgradient convergence guarantees can be applied in learning pipelines.
